name: IBY_GEN_DOCS_PAYABLE
description: IBY_GEN_DOCS_PAYABLE serves as a template for source product tables or views from which Oracle Payables can import documents payable.

columns.name: PAY_PROC_TRXN_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of payment processing transaction or document

columns.name: CALLING_APP_ID
columns.description: Source product Identifier

columns.name: CALLING_APP_DOC_UNIQUE_REF1
columns.description: Source product's first unique document payable Identifier

columns.name: CALLING_APP_DOC_UNIQUE_REF2
columns.description: Source product's second unique document payable Identifier

columns.name: CALLING_APP_DOC_UNIQUE_REF3
columns.description: Source product's third unique document payable Identifier

columns.name: CALLING_APP_DOC_UNIQUE_REF4
columns.description: Source product's fourth unique document payable Identifier

columns.name: CALLING_APP_DOC_UNIQUE_REF5
columns.description: Calling application's fifth unique document payable identifier

columns.name: CALLING_APP_DOC_REF_NUMBER
columns.description: Reference number entered by user of the source product. Need not be unique

columns.name: CALL_APP_PAY_SERVICE_REQ_CODE
columns.description: Source product's payment process request identifier. Since the source product's Identifiers may be alphanumeric, even numeric document Identifiers are stored as VARCHAR2.

columns.name: PAYMENT_FUNCTION
columns.description: Function or purpose of the payment. Values from the lookup IBY_PAYMENT_FUNCTIONS include SUPPLIER_PAYMENT, CUSTOMER_REFUNDS, and others.

columns.name: PAYMENT_DATE
columns.description: Payment date

columns.name: DOCUMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date of document

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE
columns.description: Type of document payable. Values from the IBY_DOCUMENT_TYPES lookup include INVOICE.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Document currency code

columns.name: DOCUMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total amount in document currency

columns.name: PAYMENT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Payment currency code

columns.name: PAYMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount to be paid in payment currency

columns.name: PAYMENT_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Payment method Identifier

columns.name: EXCLUSIVE_PAYMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N flag indicating whether this document payable corresponds to one payment.

columns.name: PAYEE_PARTY_ID
columns.description: TCA party Identifier

columns.name: PARTY_SITE_ID
columns.description: Payee party site Identifier

columns.name: SUPPLIER_SITE_ID
columns.description: Supplier site Identifier

columns.name: BENEFICIARY_PARTY
columns.description: Beneficiary party, if payment is made through a third party

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Legal entity Identifier

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: ORG_TYPE
columns.description: Organization type. Values from the lookup IBY_ORGANIZATION_TYPES include Operating Unit, Business Group, and Legal Entity.

columns.name: INVOICING_ORG_ID
columns.description: Invoicing business unit

columns.name: INVOICING_ORG_TYPE
columns.description: Invoicing organization type

columns.name: ALLOW_REMOVING_DOCUMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No flag indicating whether this document can be removed from a payment or payment process request

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ANTICIPATED_VALUE_DATE
columns.description: Anticipated value date

columns.name: PO_NUMBER
columns.description: Purchase order numbers to which this document is matched. If multiple purchase orders, value is comma delimited.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Document description

columns.name: DOCUMENT_CURRENCY_TAX_AMOUNT
columns.description: Tax amount in document currency

columns.name: DOCUMENT_CURR_CHARGE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Charge amount in document currency

columns.name: AMOUNT_WITHHELD
columns.description: Amount withheld in payment currency

columns.name: PAYMENT_CURR_DISCOUNT_TAKEN
columns.description: Discount taken in payment currency

columns.name: DISCOUNT_DATE
columns.description: Discount date

columns.name: PAYMENT_DUE_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the payment is made

columns.name: PAYMENT_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: Payment process profile Identifier

columns.name: INTERNAL_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Internal bank account Identifier

columns.name: EXTERNAL_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: External bank account Identifier

columns.name: BANK_CHARGE_BEARER
columns.description: Bearer of bank charge cost. Bank charge bearers are defined as the lookup IBY_BANK_CHARGE_BEARER.

columns.name: INTEREST_RATE
columns.description: Interest rate based on which this document payable was created if it is an interest invoice

columns.name: PAYMENT_GROUPING_NUMBER
columns.description: This attribute is used to link a set of documents payable. All documents payable that have the same payment grouping number are grouped into a single payment.

columns.name: PAYMENT_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Payment reason code

columns.name: PAYMENT_REASON_COMMENTS
columns.description: Free text field available for entering a reason for the payment

columns.name: SETTLEMENT_PRIORITY
columns.description: Priority with which the financial institution or payment system settles payment for this document. The available values for this column come from the FND lookup IBY_SETTLEMENT_PRIORITY.

columns.name: REMITTANCE_MESSAGE1
columns.description: Remittance message for use in payment processing

columns.name: REMITTANCE_MESSAGE2
columns.description: Remittance message for use in payment processing

columns.name: REMITTANCE_MESSAGE3
columns.description: Remittance message for use in payment processing

columns.name: UNIQUE_REMITTANCE_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: Unique remittance Identifier provided by the payee

columns.name: URI_CHECK_DIGIT
columns.description: Unique remittance Identifier check digit

columns.name: DELIVERY_CHANNEL_CODE
columns.description: Delivery channel code

columns.name: PAYMENT_FORMAT_CODE
columns.description: Payment format code

columns.name: DOCUMENT_SEQUENCE_ID
columns.description: Sequential numbering document sequence Identifier

columns.name: DOCUMENT_SEQUENCE_VALUE
columns.description: Sequence number of document payable

columns.name: DOCUMENT_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Sequential numbering document category

columns.name: BANK_ASSIGNED_REF_CODE
columns.description: Payment system-provided reference code for this document

columns.name: REMIT_TO_LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Remit-To address Identifier
